2760-4279-7286.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-7286.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-7286.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1719-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1719-4613-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1719-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1322-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-3814-5475.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-3814-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-3814-5475.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

728-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2111-3545-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

553-819-6108.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using High Fae Trickster.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1978-2585-7714.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Grim Monolith that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Grim Monolith token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Grim Monolith token.
Repeat from step 5.

1594-4399-4518-5468.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3457-5984-7791.description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Moonscarred Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Repeat.

2713-7426-7628-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2713-7426-7628-7737.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

662-2388-4428-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
662-2388-4428-6587.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

206-1550-2105.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
206-1550-2105.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1006-1438.easyPrerequisites:
Wolfhunter's Quiver attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1006-1438.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1006-1438.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2173-3661-5220-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2105-3719-5686-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-3719-5686-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1766-3767-3918-4875.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
1766-3767-3918-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
1766-3767-3918-4875.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1069-1232-1251-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-1251-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

4763-4955-5004-6068.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-710-1052.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1879-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1879-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

344-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Skullsnatcher does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
344-2792-3489.description:
Declare Skullsnatcher as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Skullsnatcher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Skullsnatcher's ninjutsu ability by paying {B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1430-4605-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Choose not to have Mirror Image copy anything as it enters the battlefield.
Mirror Image dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Preston triggers, creating a copy of Mirror Image that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Choose to have the Mirror Image token enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When the Mirror Image token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Mirror Image to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

864-2292-3235-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
864-2292-3235-3821.description:
During an opponent's combat step, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Wake the Dead by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake and Eternal Witness enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Wake the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Peregrine Drake and Eternal Witness, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

630-654-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
630-654-2893-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {G}{G}.
Repeat.

46-1091-5005.notablePrerequisites:
At least 1 instant or sorcery in hand with mana available to cast it.
{2}{U} also available.
46-1091-5005.description:
Cast the spell in your hand.
In response cast Refuse // Cooperate from your graveyard to copy it.
Sevinne, the Chronoclasm's ability triggers copying Refuse // Cooperate.
Copy the original Refuse // Cooperate.
Repeat.
For each copy made Ral, Storm Conduit will trigger dealing 1 damage to an opponent.

2034-2842-3054-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {2}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve Pitiless Plunderer's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve Blood Artist's ability, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
